messages:
oli (AE): RidgePoint sent an RFI asking for a 2-week POC: private deployment into their VPC, BYOH HSM (PKCS#11), 7yr audit retention, embeddings ~80 QPS and gen ~25 QPS. They want a capability matrix, short test plan, and ballpark pricing. Need draft by EOD tomorrow.
jamie (Sales Eng): Got it. Quick clarifiers: region? token lengths? are they ok with a Redwood-managed HSM fallback for day 1?
oli (AE): Region is us-west-2. Embeddings ~384 tokens, gen avg 200 tokens. They prefer BYOH but will accept managed HSM temporarily.
keisha (Solutions): I'll put together the capability matrix (Requirement / Redwood capability / Notes) and attach BYOH playbook + sample deploy YAML. Will include risk items: HSM latency, peering lead time, storage TCO for 7yr retention.
tom (SRE): Technical notes: PKCS#11 over peering typically adds ~5-15ms per crypto op; validate HSM ops/sec during POC. For targets recommend 3x A10x + tuned batching for embeddings. Peering provisioning 24-48h. Audit retention ok but separate storage charge.
jamie (Sales Eng): Preliminary pricing (placeholder): 3 GPUs x 2 weeks = $13,500; peering/onboarding = $2,000; SE support (2 days) = $3,200; audit storage delta ~$140/mo. I'll refine after Keisha posts the matrix.
keisha (Solutions): Example config snippet I'll attach:
```
deployment:
  mode: private
  region: us-west-2
  vpc_peering: true
  hsm:
    interface: "pkcs11"
    endpoint: "tcp://10.4.5.6:7777"
  audit:
    retention_days: 2555
```
file-bot: uploaded: "byoh-hsm-playbook-v6.pdf" to /internal/playbooks (link placeholder).
tom (SRE): I'll add a short test-plan to validate HSM ops/sec, p95 gen latency @200 tokens, embeddings QPS at 80, and audit log retention checks. Also note fallback: Redwood-managed HSM with customer key import and SLA differences.
oli (AE): Great — please drop draft in /sales/ridgepoint/rfi-draft and ping me. Procurement needs a one-page summary for legal by tomorrow AM. Thanks all :thumbsup:
